title: "Cars"
execute:
  echo: false
---

## Stopping distance

```{r}
#| label: fit
fit <- lm(dist ~ speed, data = cars)
slope <- coef(fit)[["speed"]]
```

```{r}
#| label: show
#| eval: false
summary(fit)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot
plot(cars)
abline(fit)
cat("each mph adds", round(slope, 2), "ft\n")
```
